The entire frame and banner are drawn in pure front elevation. The top posts, upper crossbeam, and lower crossbeam show no horizontal top surfaces (only flat front faces with 2D specular shine highlights across rows 6-7 and row 42).

The top horizontal beam clearly displays a 3-pixel-tall top surface (rows 6–8) with top illumination/highlight, above a shaded 3-pixel front face (rows 9–11). The bottom beam similarly features a visible top surface (rows 41–43) above its front face.
